Adds the option to call for a Merchant whenever you need him.

The first options are there to set the frequency the merchant will appear
tommorow - Merchant will arrive the next day (everdyday)
10days - Merchant will arrive in 1-10days
20days - Merchant arrives every 10-20days
30days - Merchant arrives every 10-30 days
Vanilla - Merchant arrives every 10-40days
more items - the merchant will have almost/all items that the game offers
reset goods - self explanitory
Call2 - Calls the merchant, its in dependency to the Range you have set
Cancel - Sending the selected merchant home
Call - The Merchant instantly arrives
